notes.title: Moving&Changing blocks UPDATE
notes.content:
v0.3 Update!
Change log:
[b]-->[/b] Added [b]change action[/b] assignable to blocks in the block editor. Change-block will be changed into another. Useful for creating animated blocks or mechanisms that change over time.
	- [b]Change-blocks[/b] can be configured in many ways:
	- [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38671986/c1317f174f490bbbb3d27c4bc90169d866ddcc2c.png[/img]
	- [b]Change list[/b] - The block will turn into items placed here. (List of blocks to change into)
	- [b]Change activation mode[/b] - How the change will be activated.
		[list]
[*]  [b]At Start[/b] - The block will start moving/changing at the start of the level or when placed ingame.
[*] 		 [b]Triggered[/b] - The block will start moving/changing when the action is triggered (the movement can't be stopped).
[*] 		 [b]Toggled[/b] - Movement/changing of the block will be toggled on/off when the action is triggered.
[/list]
	- [b]Changing order[/b] - In what order the blocks will be displayed (changed).
		[list]
[*]  [b]Row by row[/b] - The blocks will be swapped in the row by row order as set in "Change list".
[*] 		 [b]Random[/b] - The blocks will be swapped in random order.
[*] 		 [b]Unique-Random[/b] - The blocks will be replaced in random order, but each will appear once in one series.
[/list]
	 [b]Changing mode[/b] - How the blocks are changed (how many changes).
		[list]
[*]  [b]Single Block[/b] - The block will be changed only once.
[*] 		 [b]Single Series[/b] - The block will keep turning into specific blocks for a certain amount of time.
[*] 		 [b]Loop[/b] - The block will keep turning into specific blocks in loop (until it is toggled off manually).
[/list]
	- [b]Change only texture[/b] - Only the block's texture will be changed, not its actions.
	- [b]Change also movement[/b] - The way the block moves will also change with the change.
	- [b]Changing speed[/b] - The speed of changing blocks (in blocks per second).

[b]-->[/b] Added [b]move action[/b] assignable to blocks in the block editor. Move-block will keep moving in specified direction. Useful for creating enemies or moving platforms and obstacles.
	- The [b]movement of blocks[/b] can also be configured in many ways:
	- [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38671986/585cfff86e0e599481ee60c0da2634cb6d2b740b.png[/img]
	- [b]Movement activation[/b] - How the movement will be activated.
		[list]
[*]  [b]At Start[/b], [b]Triggered[/b], [b]Toggled[/b] same as above.
[/list]
	- [b]Movement direction[/b] - In which direction the block will move.
		[list]
[*]  [b]Up[/b] - The block will move up.
[*] 		 [b]UpRight[/b] - The block will move diagonally up and to the right.
[*] 		 [b]Right[/b] - The block will move to the right.
[*] 		 [b]DownRight[/b] - The block will move diagonally down and to the right.
[*] 		 [b]Down[/b] - The block will move down.
[*] 		 [b]DownLeft[/b] - The block will move diagonally down and to the left.
[*] 		 [b]Left[/b] - The block will move to the left.
[*] 		 [b]UpLeft[/b] - The block will move diagonally up and to the left.
[/list]
	- [b]Rotation on collision[/b] - How should the block movement change when it encounters an obstacle.
		[list]
[*]  [b]None (0)[/b] - The block will not change its direction of movement when it encounters an obstacle.
[*] 		 [b]Turn HalfRight (+45)[/b] - The block will change its direction of movement 45 degrees to the right when it encounters an obstacle.
[*] 		 [b]Turn Right (+90)[/b] - 90 degrees to the right
[*] 		 [b]Turn Right&Half (+135)[/b] - 135 degrees to the right
[*] 		 [b]Turn Around (180)[/b] - changes direction of movement by 180 degrees
[*] 		 [b]Turn Left&Half (-135)[/b] - 135 degrees to the left
[*] 		 [b]Turn Left (-90)[/b] - 90 degrees to the left
[*] 		 [b]Turn HalfLeft (-45)[/b] - 45 degrees to the left
[*] 		 [b]Turn Smart (+-90 / 180)[/b] - When the block encounters an obstacle first it will try to go to its left or right, and if there are blocks on both sides, it will turn around.
[*] 		 [b]Random (?)[/b] - changes direction of movement by random degrees
[*] 		 [b]Bounce (/\\)[/b] - The block will change (one dimension of) its movement direction to the opposite - As if it bounced off the encountered obstacle.
[/list]
	- [b]Rotate texture[/b] - The texture of the block will be rotated when the block hits an obstacle while moving.
	- [b]Wait for rotation[/b] - The block will not move until the texture rotates.
	- [b]Trigger encountered [/b]- The block will activate the actions of the blocks it encounters on its way. (Force-blocks, which usually push the player in a certain direction, in this case will change the direction of the block's movement.)
	- [b]Discrete movement[/b] - If true, the block will move by teleportation; otherwise will move lineary.
	- [b]Collide with non-solids[/b] - If true, the block will treat non-solid blocks as an obstacle.
	- [b]Movement speed[/b] - The speed of the block (in blocks per second).

[b]-->[/b] Some other minor improvements and bug-fixes.

notes.title: Block Editor, Equipment and Crafting UPDATE!
notes.content:
New update is available! v0.2
New features:
- Block Editor integrated with the Steam Workshop - now you can create your own blocks! The blocks can be set up in many ways, they can explode, vanish, serve as a chest or a crafting table, and much more!
- Minecraft-like equipment & crafting
- Ability to create own crafting recipes
- Some bugs fixed
